baseline: Baseline — network as it operates today

steps.title: Change Kokopo–Bougainville service from fortnightly to monthly
steps.detail: Renegotiate the charter or freight agreement and republish the distribution calendar to every facility on the run.
steps.risk: Carrier availability. Confirm the operator can hold the new slot.
steps.evidence: Timetable lever changed for service 'Kokopo–Bougainville service'.
